C1027.title: Former Employee Account Used to Breach Corporate Internal Network
C1027.summary: In February 2024, CISA and MS-ISAC issued an alert after a state government organization received an incident response assessment because documents containing host and user information had been posted on a dark web brokerage site. The analysis confirmed that an unidentified threat actor used a former employee account to compromise network administrator credentials, authenticated to an internal VPN access point, continued accessing the victim's on-premises environment, and executed LDAP queries; no lateral movement from the on-premises environment to Azure was found.
